query:
MATCH p=(g:Group)<-[:MemberOf*1..]-(u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
WHERE g.name =~ "(?i).*DOMAIN ADMINS.*" AND a.category = "remote_access"
RETURN p
name: Profilehound - Remote Access Artifacts for Domain Admin Users
description: Shows remote access artifacts for Domain Admin users.
